description: Approves a car wash at 210 Orban Way.
Includes two commercial retail units with patio space.
Replaces an expired 2022 discretionary use approval.

chips.text: No public feedback received on the car wash application.

description: Approves a commercial school for two students, two instructors.
Requires development and building permits at 115 Radu Crescent.

chips.text: Focus Goaltending can operate a commercial school at 115 Radu Crescent.

description: Rezoning land in Brighton Traeger Common for residential development.
Allows low to medium density housing, including townhouses.
This aligns with the existing Brighton concept plan.

chips.text: Councillor Ford questioned traffic, parking, and services for the proposed density.
No public speakers addressed Council regarding the rezoning application.

description: Removes 1.1 hectares near Carcourt Street for industrial use.
Adjusts land use boundaries for a future hotel site.
Removes a flex zone boundary north of the clubhouse.

chips.text: No major public concerns were raised regarding the proposed amendments.

description: Re-designates 1.18 hectares in The Willows to light industrial.

chips.text: No public speakers addressed Council regarding the proposed land use change.

description: Rezones 1.18 hectares in The Willows to light industrial.
Removes holding symbol from IL-1 land near Larn Avenue.
Allows development once site servicing is complete.

chips.text: No members of the public spoke regarding this rezoning application.
